description: Create a new Lagos Life account (sign-up). Use for operator broadcast accounts: username must start with announcement (3–20 letters, numbers, or _). Collect password via emit_display input. On success, session cookies are set; store credentials in tenant globals / broadcast account registry.

lagoslife_register_name.description: Display name (default Ada Okonkwo; avoid team-style names).

lagoslife_register_username.description: Desired username without @. Official broadcast accounts: must start with announcement.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: register
